name: STACK MUTINY
licensing_note: Original orchestration text only; upstream references are not bundled. Review individual source licenses before any source redistribution.

packs.title: SHIP OR IT DIDN'T HAPPEN
packs.tagline: Ideas don't pass tests. Software does.
packs.description: Ship a small code change with reproducible evidence rather than celebratory prose.

upstream_candidates.reason: Domain modeling and engineering review patterns

packs.deliverable: A runnable change or clear refusal, passing or failing test evidence, and a 30-second product demonstration plan.
packs.failure_condition: Do not claim shipped, tested, merged or deployed unless the exact command, commit and artifact substantiate it.

packs.title: STOP SHIPPING BEIGE
packs.tagline: Taste is a discipline, not a prompt.
packs.hook: References → art direction → implementation → adversarial critique.
packs.description: Make a distinctive interface with an explicit visual point of view and a documented UX review.

upstream_candidates.reason: UI critique, accessibility, visual hierarchy and craft
Design references, palettes and interface patterns
Design-system documentation and React component conversion

packs.deliverable: One implemented, visually reviewed screen with an editable design specification, screenshots and known limitations.
packs.failure_condition: No invented visual review, inaccessible reference claims, unrelated stock photos or untested pixel-perfect promises.

packs.title: NO PERMISSION REQUIRED
packs.tagline: Find a need. Make something real.
packs.hook: Observed pain → alternatives → test → offer → first customer.
packs.description: Turn an idea into a bounded opportunity with a falsifiable first test and the smallest useful product.

upstream_candidates.reason: Community discovery, validation, first customers and pricing

packs.deliverable: One-page evidence-linked opportunity memo, first offer, test plan and decision ledger.
packs.failure_condition: Do not invent interviews, customer willingness to pay, revenue, conversion or market sizing.

packs.title: ANTI-GURU
packs.tagline: Marketing that can survive a fact-check.
packs.hook: Audience → promise → proof → channel → measurable experiment.
packs.description: Build truthful distribution and conversion experiments without fake social proof or generic content volume.

upstream_candidates.reason: Research, copy, conversion and channel strategy
Recent public conversation research where access is permitted

packs.deliverable: One campaign brief with truthful claims, source-linked copy, distribution plan and measurable test.
packs.failure_condition: Never fabricate customers, testimonials, benchmark results, case studies, urgency or social engagement.

packs.title: SHOW THE RECEIPTS
packs.tagline: An attractive story is not evidence.
packs.description: Research a possible investment or company with source provenance, financial-model caveats and explicit unknowns.

upstream_candidates.reason: Finance, research and business strategy skill candidates
Financial document extraction and DCF workflow reference
Financial data and analytics reference, not an Agent Skill

packs.deliverable: A diligence memo with dated sources, documented assumptions, adverse-case analysis and missing-information register.
packs.failure_condition: No fabricated financials, private records, market-share figures, returns, valuation certainty or investment recommendation presented as fact.
